    94→<script setup lang="ts">
    95→import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch, nextTick } from 'vue'
    96→import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
    97→import { createChart, CandlestickSeries, HistogramSeries, type IChartApi } from 'lightweight-charts'
    98→import client from '@/api/client'
    99→
   100→const route = useRoute()
   101→const ticker = route.params.ticker as string
   102→const chartContainer = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
   103→const stockName = ref('')
   104→
   105→// --- K線圖 ---
   106→const period = ref('3mo')
   107→const loading = ref(false)
   108→const error = ref('')
   109→const periods = [
   110→  { label: '1M', value: '1mo' },
   111→  { label: '3M', value: '3mo' },
   112→  { label: '6M', value: '6mo' },
   113→  { label: '1Y', value: '1y' },
   114→]
   115→
   116→// --- 壓力支撐 ---
   117→const chartType = ref<'candle' | 'profile'>('candle')
   118→const contentVisible = ref(true)
   119→const profilePeriod = ref('3mo')
   120→const profileLoading = ref(false)
   121→const profileError = ref('')
   122→const profileData = ref<{ label: string; price_low: number; price_high: number; volume: number; type: string }[]>([])
   123→const profilePeriods = [
   124→  { label: '近季', value: '3mo' },
   125→  { label: '近月', value: '1mo' },
   126→  { label: '近周', value: '5d' },
   127→]
   128→const profileMaxVolume = computed(() =>
   129→  profileData.value.reduce((max, r) => Math.max(max, r.volume), 1),
   130→)
   131→
   132→function formatVol(v: number): string {
   133→  if (v >= 1_000_000) return (v / 1_000_000).toFixed(1) + 'M'
   134→  if (v >= 1_000) return (v / 1_000).toFixed(0) + 'K'
   135→  return String(v)
   136→}
   137→
   138→// --- Lightweight chart ---
   139→let chart: IChartApi | null = null
   140→let candleSeries: any = null
   141→let volumeSeries: any = null
   142→
   143→async function loadChart() {
   144→  loading.value = true
   145→  error.value = ''
   146→  try {
   147→    const res = await client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/chart`, { params: { period: period.value } })
   148→    const data = res.data
   149→    if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   150→      error.value = '查無資料'
   151→      return
   152→    }
   153→    if (candleSeries) candleSeries.setData(data)
   154→    if (volumeSeries) {
   155→      volumeSeries.setData(
   156→        data.map((d: any) => ({
   157→          time: d.time,
   158→          value: d.volume,
   159→          color: d.close >= d.open ? 'rgba(38, 166, 154, 0.5)' : 'rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.5)',
   160→        })),
   161→      )
   162→    }
   163→    chart?.timeScale().fitContent()
   164→  } catch (e: any) {
   165→    error.value = e?.response?.data?.detail ?? '載入失敗，請稍後再試'
   166→  } finally {
   167→    loading.value = false
   168→  }
   169→}
   170→
   171→async function loadProfile() {
   172→  profileLoading.value = true
   173→  profileError.value = ''
   174→  try {
   175→    const res = await client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/volume-profile`, {
   176→      params: { period: profilePeriod.value },
   177→    })
   178→    profileData.value = res.data
   179→  } catch (e: any) {
   180→    profileError.value = e?.response?.data?.detail ?? '載入失敗，請稍後再試'
   181→  } finally {
   182→    profileLoading.value = false
   183→  }
   184→}
   185→
   186→async function loadStockName() {
   187→  try {
   188→    const res = await client.get('/stocks/search', { params: { q: ticker.replace('.TW', '').replace('.TWO', '') } })
   189→    const match = res.data.find((s: any) => s.ticker === ticker)
   190→    if (match) stockName.value = match.name
   191→  } catch {}
   192→}
   193→
   194→function changePeriod(p: string) {
   195→  period.value = p
   196→}
   197→
   198→function changeProfilePeriod(p: string) {
   199→  profilePeriod.value = p
   200→}
   201→
   202→function chartHeight() {
   203→  return window.innerWidth <= 640 ? 300 : 420
   204→}
   205→
   206→async function switchChartType(type: 'candle' | 'profile') {
   207→  if (type === chartType.value) return
   208→  // fade out
   209→  contentVisible.value = false
   210→  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150))
   211→  // switch tab
   212→  chartType.value = type
   213→  if (type === 'profile' && profileData.value.length === 0) {
   214→    loadProfile()
   215→  }
   216→  if (type === 'candle') {
   217→    await nextTick()
   218→    if (chartContainer.value) {
   219→      chart?.resize(chartContainer.value.clientWidth, chartHeight())
   220→    }
   221→    chart?.timeScale().fitContent()
   222→  }
   223→  // fade in
   224→  await nextTick()
   225→  contentVisible.value = true
   226→}
   227→
   228→watch(period, loadChart)
   229→watch(profilePeriod, () => {
   230→  if (chartType.value === 'profile') loadProfile()
   231→})
   232→
   233→onMounted(async () => {
   234→  if (!chartContainer.value) return
   235→  loadStockName()
   236→
   237→  // 支援 ?tab=profile 直接切換到分價圖
   238→  if (route.query.tab === 'profile') {
   239→    chartType.value = 'profile'
   240→    loadProfile()
   241→  }
   242→
   243→  chart = createChart(chartContainer.value, {
   244→    height: chartHeight(),
   245→    layout: {
   246→      background: { color: '#0d1829' },
   247→      textColor: '#4a7aad',
   248→    },
   249→    grid: {
   250→      vertLines: { color: '#111f35' },
   251→      horzLines: { color: '#111f35' },
   252→    },
   253→    crosshair: {
   254→      vertLine: { color: '#1e3a5f', labelBackgroundColor: '#1e3a5f' },
   255→      horzLine: { color: '#1e3a5f', labelBackgroundColor: '#1e3a5f' },
   256→    },
   257→    timeScale: {
   258→      borderColor: '#1e3a5f',
   259→      timeVisible: true,
   260→    },
   261→    rightPriceScale: {
   262→      borderColor: '#1e3a5f',
   263→    },
   264→  })
   265→
   266→  candleSeries = chart.addSeries(CandlestickSeries, {
   267→    upColor: '#26a69a',
   268→    downColor: '#ef5350',
   269→    borderVisible: false,
   270→    wickUpColor: '#26a69a',
   271→    wickDownColor: '#ef5350',
   272→  })
   273→
   274→  volumeSeries = chart.addSeries(HistogramSeries, {
   275→    priceFormat: { type: 'volume' },
   276→    priceScaleId: 'volume',
   277→  })
   278→  chart.priceScale('volume').applyOptions({ scaleMargins: { top: 0.8, bottom: 0 } })
   279→
   280→  const handleResize = () => {
   281→    if (chartContainer.value) {
   282→      chart?.resize(chartContainer.value.clientWidth, chartHeight())
   283→    }
   284→  }
   285→  window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)
   286→  onUnmounted(() => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize))
   287→
   288→  await loadChart()
   289→})
   290→
   291→onUnmounted(() => {
   292→  chart?.remove()
   293→})
   294→</script>

   140→  const q = query.value.trim()
   141→  if (q.length < 1) {
   142→    suggestions.value = []
   143→    return
   144→  }
   145→  searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
   146→    if (q.length < 2) return
   147→    searching.value = true
   148→    try {

   150→      suggestions.value = res.data
   151→    } catch {
   152→      suggestions.value = []
   153→    } finally {
   154→      searching.value = false
   155→    }
   156→  }, 300)
   157→}
   158→
   159→function moveSuggestion(dir: number) {

   161→  if (!len) return

   174→  loading.value = true
   175→  error.value = ''
   176→  stockInfo.value = null
   177→  priceInfo.value = null
   178→  try {
   179→    const [infoRes, priceRes] = await Promise.all([
   180→      client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/info`),
   181→      client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/price`),

   183→    stockInfo.value = infoRes.data
   184→    priceInfo.value = priceRes.data
   185→  } catch (e: any) {
   186→    error.value = e?.response?.data?.detail ?? '載入失敗，請稍後再試'
   187→  } finally {
   188→    loading.value = false
   189→  }

   195→  if (val >= 1e4) return (val / 1e4).toFixed(2) + ' 萬'

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I see the issue in `loadStock` - it uses `Promise.all` for both info and price requests. If either fails (502/404), the whole Promise.all rejects and shows an error. But the issue is that for `7610.TWO`, both /info and /price are failing with 502.

Now, the current behavior:
- Both requests fail → `error.value = 'Stock data not available'`
